summary.recognitionSettings: English, CPU int8, beam size 5, temperature 0, no initial prompt or transcript hints, VAD disabled, independent files with no previous text conditioning.
summary.recognitionScope: 123 baseline full clips and 246 baseline encoded prefixes; 26 full-line medium-model rechecks; 11 full-line large-model rechecks; two Troll candidate stage sets with small and medium models; 17 diagnostic variants for four uncertain voices.
summary.normalization: Basic matching ignores case and punctuation. The equivalent class additionally expands I'd've/I'd have and it's; joins some time; separates weightclass; maps choppin/chopping, ya/you and honourable/honorable; and ignores apostrophe placement.
summary.acceptanceLimit: All sources and signal checks pass. Nine full lines have partial ASR word disagreements and Spectre's full-line words remain model-unverified. No claim of human listening, actor verification, physical-speaker playback, or subjective difficulty is made.
